class.name: YAML
class.brief_description: Converts between YAML text and Godot data structures.
class.description: Main interface for working with YAML in Godot, providing methods to parse, validate, and serialize YAML data. Serves as the entry point for interacting with YAML functionality. YAML (YAML Ain't Markup Language) is a human-friendly data serialization standard commonly used for configuration files, data exchange, and storing structured information in a readable format. This class automatically handles conversion between YAML and standard Godot variant types, except for [Callable] and [RID].

method.name: allow_resource_path
method.description:
Allows resource loading from a specific path prefix for the default security instance. If [param type_names] is empty, allows all non-blocked resource types from this path. This method delegates to the default [YAMLSecurity] instance. For more control, create a custom [YAMLSecurity] instance using [method create_security]. [codeblocks] [gdscript] # Allow all non-blocked resource types from the assets directory YAML.allow_resource_path("res://assets/")
# Allow only specific resource types from the textures directory YAML.allow_resource_path("res://textures/", ["Texture2D", "Image"])
# Parse YAML with resource references var yaml_string = """ player: sprite: !Resource res://assets/player.png scene: !Resource res://scenes/player.tscn """ var result = YAML.parse(yaml_string) [/gdscript] [/codeblocks]

method.name: block_resource_type
method.description:
Blocks a specific resource type globally for the default security instance. Any resource of this type will be rejected during parsing. This method delegates to the default [YAMLSecurity] instance. For more control, create a custom [YAMLSecurity] instance using [method create_security]. [codeblocks] [gdscript] # Block AudioStreamMP3 resources YAML.block_resource_type("AudioStreamMP3")
# Parse YAML with resource references var yaml_string = """ resources: image: !Resource res://textures/sprite.png audio: !Resource res://sounds/music.mp3 """
var result = YAML.parse(yaml_string) # The audio resource won't load due to type restriction [/gdscript] [/codeblocks]

method.name: create_security
method.description:
Creates a new security configuration object for controlling resource loading during YAML parsing. [codeblocks] [gdscript] # Create custom security settings var security = YAML.create_security()
# Configure security security.allow_path("res://assets/") security.block_type("Script")
# Parse YAML with custom security settings var yaml_string = """ player: sprite: !Resource res://assets/player.png script: !Resource res://scripts/player.gd """ var result = YAML.parse(yaml_string, false, security) [/gdscript] [/codeblocks]

method.name: create_style
method.description:
Creates a new style configuration object for customizing YAML serialization. [codeblocks] [gdscript] # Create a custom style var style = YAML.create_style()
# Configure style style.set_scalar_style(YAMLStyle.SCALAR_LITERAL) style.set_quote_style(YAMLStyle.QUOTE_DOUBLE)
# Convert data to YAML with custom style var data = { "name": "Player", "description": "A player character", "inventory": ["Sword", "Shield", "Potion"] } var result = YAML.stringify(data, style) var yaml = result.get_data() print(yaml) # Output might look like: # name: "Player" # description: | # A player character # inventory: # - "Sword" # - "Shield" # - "Potion" [/gdscript] [/codeblocks]

method.name: has_registered_class
method.description:
Returns [code]true[/code] if a class is registered for YAML serialization with the given tag name. [codeblocks] [gdscript] # Define and register a custom class class_name Player
var name: String var level: int
static func deserialize(dict): var p = Player.new() p.name = dict.get("name", "") p.level = dict.get("level", 1) return p
func serialize(): return {"name": name, "level": level}
# In _ready or elsewhere YAML.register_class(Player)
# Check if class is registered print(YAML.has_registered_class("Player")) # Output: true [/gdscript] [/codeblocks]

method.name: parse
method.description:
Parses a YAML string into Godot data structures. Returns a [YAMLResult] containing either the parsed data or error information. If [param detect_style] is [code]true[/code], the method also detects and returns style information that can be used to preserve formatting when modifying and re-serializing the YAML. If [param security] is provided, it will be used to validate resource loading. Otherwise, the default security settings will be used. Multi-document YAML (separated by [code]---[/code]) is fully supported, allowing you to access each document individually through [method YAMLResult.get_document] or [method YAMLResult.get_data] with an index parameter. [codeblocks] [gdscript] # Basic parsing var yaml_string = """ player: name: Hero level: 10 inventory: - Sword - Shield - Potion """
var result = YAML.parse(yaml_string) if result.has_error(): print("Error: ", result.get_error_message()) print("At line: ", result.get_error_line(), ", column: ", result.get_error_column()) else: var data = result.get_data() print("Player name: ", data.player.name) print("Inventory: ", data.player.inventory)
# Parsing with style detection var styled_yaml = """ regular: value flow_style: {a: 1, b: 2} block_scalar: | This is a multiline string with preserved newlines """
var styled_result = YAML.parse(styled_yaml, true) if !styled_result.has_error() && styled_result.has_style(): var data = styled_result.get_data() var style = styled_result.get_style()
# Modify data data.regular = "new value"
# Re-emit with preserved style var output = YAML.stringify(data, style).get_data() print(output)
# Parsing multi-document YAML var multi_doc = """ # First document title: Document 1 --- # Second document title: Document 2 """
var multi_result = YAML.parse(multi_doc) if !multi_result.has_error(): print("Number of documents: ", multi_result.get_document_count()) print("First document title: ", multi_result.get_document(0).title) print("Second document title: ", multi_result.get_document(1).title) [/gdscript] [/codeblocks]

method.name: register_class
method.description:
Registers a custom script class for YAML serialization and deserialization. The [param script_class] must be a Script resource. The class should implement two methods: 1. A serialization method (default name: [code]serialize[/code]) that returns a serializable representation of the object 2. A static deserialization method (default name: [code]deserialize[/code]) that takes a value and returns a new instance of the class The [param serialize] and [param deserialize] parameters can be used to specify custom method names if the class uses different names. Once registered, the class can be automatically serialized to and from YAML with proper type information preserved using YAML tags. [codeblocks] [gdscript] # Define a custom class class_name Player extends Node
var name: String var level: int var inventory: Array
func _init(p_name = "", p_level = 1): name = p_name level = p_level inventory = []
static func deserialize(data): # Can accept any value type, not just Dictionary if typeof(data) == TYPE_DICTIONARY: var player = Player.new(data.get("name", ""), data.get("level", 1)) player.inventory = data.get("inventory", []) return player else: # Handle other data types as needed return Player.new(str(data), 1)
func serialize(): # Can return any serializable value return { "name": name, "level": level, "inventory": inventory }
# Register the class with YAML func _ready(): # Default registration using serialize() and deserialize() methods YAML.register_class(Player)
# Or with custom method names # YAML.register_class(Player, "to_yaml", "from_yaml")
# Now you can serialize and deserialize Player objects var player = Player.new("Hero", 10) player.inventory = ["Sword", "Shield", "Potion"]
var data = {"player": player}
# Serialize to YAML var yaml = YAML.stringify(data).get_data() print(yaml) # Output: # player: !Player # name: Hero # level: 10 # inventory: # - Sword # - Shield # - Potion
# Deserialize from YAML var parsed = YAML.parse(yaml).get_data() var restored_player = parsed.player print(restored_player.name) # Hero [/gdscript] [/codeblocks] For custom validation and error handling, your [code]deserialize[/code] method can return a [YAMLResult] object: [codeblocks] [gdscript] static func deserialize(data): # Example handling any data type match typeof(data): TYPE_DICTIONARY: # Process dictionary data if !data.has("name"): return YAMLResult.error("Player class missing required 'name' field") var player = Player.new(data.name, data.get("level", 1)) return player TYPE_STRING: # Perhaps a string represents a player name return Player.new(data, 1) TYPE_ARRAY: # Maybe an array holds [name, level] if data.size() >= 2: return Player.new(data[0], data[1]) return Player.new(data[0] if data.size() > 0 else "", 1) _: return YAMLResult.error("Unsupported data type for Player: %s" % type_string(typeof(data))) [/gdscript] [/codeblocks]

method.name: reset_security
method.description:
Resets the default security settings to defaults. Clears all custom settings and re-adds the default blocked types (Script and GDExtension). This method delegates to the default [YAMLSecurity] instance. [codeblocks] [gdscript] # Customize default security settings YAML.allow_resource_path("res://assets/") YAML.block_resource_type("AudioStreamMP3")
# Later, reset to defaults YAML.reset_security()
# Now only the default restrictions apply (Script and GDExtension blocked) [/gdscript] [/codeblocks]

method.name: stringify
validate
method.description:
Validates YAML syntax without full parsing. Returns a [YAMLResult] indicating success or containing error information. This method quickly checks if YAML is syntactically valid without creating full Godot data structures. It's faster than [method parse] but doesn't provide the parsed data. [codeblocks] [gdscript] # Validate YAML syntax var yaml_string = "key: value\ninvalid -list" var validation = YAML.validate(yaml_string) if validation.has_error(): print("Invalid YAML: ", validation.get_error_message()) print("At line: ", validation.get_error_line(), ", column: ", validation.get_error_column()) else: print("YAML syntax is valid")
# Another example with valid YAML var valid_yaml = """ player: name: Hero stats: strength: 10 agility: 8 intelligence: 12 inventory: - name: Sword damage: 5 - name: Potion effect: Healing """
validation = YAML.validate(valid_yaml) if !validation.has_error(): print("YAML is valid, proceed with parsing") var result = YAML.parse(valid_yaml) # Process the data... [/gdscript] [/codeblocks]

method.name: version
method.description: Returns the version of the YAML extension as a string with version and build information. [codeblocks] [gdscript] # Get YAML extension version var version = YAML.version() print(version) # Output might look like: "Godot YAML 1.0.0 (release)" [/gdscript] [/codeblocks]
